axis: the plain feeling of being set against someone → deep, bitter anger and ill will that will not stay a feeling

members.tone: Anger and ill will that have settled and deepened, held against someone rather than flaring at them.
Names the same deep anger and ill will as a souring the person carries, where *resentment* keeps it pointed at whoever earned it.
The rawest word for that deep anger and ill will, giving it the taste of bile that *bitterness* only implies.
Cooler and more measured than *gall*, yet the only one here whose ill will is already rousing itself into open hostility.
The plainest naming of the feeling — being set against someone, without the bitter taste or the nursed grievance the others carry.
